name: Above the Pearl Tattoo, LLC
bio:
Welcome to Above the Pearl Tattoo, LLC in the creative heart of Portland, where artistry meets individuality. Specializing in illustrative designs, our skilled artists are masters of transformation, offering bespoke tattoos, cover-ups, reworks, and healing mastectomy tattoos with a compassionate touch. Book a consultation at www.abovethepearl.com and begin your journey to self-expression in a studio that values your unique story.

Current location: Portland, Oregon, United States

Tattoos by Tanya Magdalena. Please visit www.abovethepearl.com for a consultation. Scar covers, mastectomy tattoos, cover-ups, reworks, custom art.
